gitCommit.body: fix(images): place photos load reliably everywhere, with fallbacks (#46) Place photos sometimes failed to show. This PR adds one fallback path that every place image now uses. **Base: `feat/map-reference-ux` (PR #45, not merged yet)**, so the new map card carousel and list view are covered. Merge #45 first. After that, this PR's diff against main will contain only these changes. ### Live check (GET/HEAD only, nothing written) - `/api/map/places` (all categories, all pages) returned 24 open places (178 locked). Every place has at least one image. - I also checked the `/api/places/search` hits, 49 `/en/places/` pages and the home, explore, itineraries and activities pages. - **226 unique image URLs (every ladder rung, AVIF and WebP), 226 × 200, 0 failures.** - None of the sampled places is missing a photo, and no rung is missing on disk. So the intermittent failures come from the client, not from the data. ### Root causes 1. **Errors before hydration were lost.** A server-rendered `` that fails before React attaches `onError` keeps the browser's broken-image icon forever. This was intermittent: it depended on network and JS timing. 2. **No retry.** `/media/*` is served by the Next server on the 2 vCPU box (force-dynamic, behind Cloudflare). One 502 or timeout meant a broken image, or the plain placeholder in `Photo`. 3. **No fallback when a rung is missing.** A requested rung that was never written (for example the 320 map thumbs vs the 1280 rungs) went straight to the placeholder. 4. **Map v3 `Thumb` had a `broken` flag that never reset**, and it used `loading="lazy"` inside the horizontal scroll-snap carousel. Lazy images in a horizontal scroller are unreliable in WebKit. 5. **Bare `` tags with no `onError`**: home category cards and the `/search` rows. 6. **The `Photo` placeholder was a flat ivory box**, because an inline background overrode `.ph-fallback`. It looked like a failed load, not a branded placeholder. 7. Studio media delete and restore did not clear the cached map place list (60 s cache). ### Fix - `imageCandidates` / `useImageFallback`: the URL → one cache-busted retry → the next smaller WebP rung → `320.webp` (always written, because the minimum source width is 320) → placeholder. State is keyed by `src`, and a mount check catches errors that fired before hydration. - `Photo` uses this, so it covers place pages, itinerary, linked places, events, favourites, trips and checkout. After a failure it drops the srcset. The placeholder is branded and callers can override it. - `PlaceThumb` shows the category glyph when a load fails. Map `Thumb` uses the same fallback, and carousel thumbs load eagerly. - Home category cards and `/search` rows now use `SafeImg`. - Every swap from image to placeholder renders inside the same CSS box, so there is no layout shift. ### Tests - Unit: `src/lib/media/fallback.test.ts` (candidate order, fallbacks always land on rungs that exist, placeholder rendering). - E2E: `e2e/full/place-images.spec.ts` forces 404s on every rung except 320, a full media outage, and one-time 502s on `/map` and a place page, then checks that no broken images remain. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01Rhcg1nc6tRTvhEFMLi883G)_
